changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate/redundant model names (context-LM/Context-LM), kept distinct model variants. Added SEQ2SEQ as it's a core model type used. Simplified outputs description.
All metrics were correctly extracted and normalized to standard forms.
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.

guideline: Turkers evaluate based on semantics (whether sentences have the same meaning), diversity (whether expressions are diverse), and fluency (whether paraphrase is fluent)
Annotators rate each generated paraphrase on a 5-point scale for semantics, diversity, and fluency

changes_made.explanation: Human evaluation criteria were correctly extracted and normalized.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on paraphrase generation using contextual regularization. Key contributions include the ConRPG pipeline with context-LM training, diverse decoding, and multi-criteria filtering. Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (BLEU, iBLEU, ROUGE) and human evaluation (semantics, diversity, fluency). No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
